summary: Turbo Energy, S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing a proxy notice and statement for its 2026 Annual General Meeting of shareholders. The meeting is scheduled for June 29, 2026, at the registered office of its controlling shareholder in Valencia, Spain. Items on the agenda are referenced but not detailed in this excerpt. The filing also provides instructions for ADS holders to vote through Citibank, N.A., the depositary, by the June 26, 2026 deadline. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is announced. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report on a standard shareholder meeting, in line with U.S. equivalent proxy materials.
